stories.title: OHSAA football playoffs: Live scoring updates from all state semifinal games involving Northeast Ohio high schools
stories.summary: Eight high school football teams from Northeast Ohio vie for state titles in the semifinals, with powerhouses and Cinderella stories set to clash.

stories.title: 'The Game': Ohio State releases hype video for rivalry game against Michigan
stories.summary: Ohio State vs. Michigan kicks off at noon on Saturday, Nov. 28.

stories.title: Cleveland Cavaliers' Mario Hezonja sponsors 33 dog adoptions at city's shelter
stories.summary: Mario Hezonja, who has six dogs of his own, visited City Dogs Cleveland with both his wife as well as Cavs teammate Jarrett Allen to help shelter dogs find homes.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 seriously injured in Wayne County crash; driver of car charged with OVI
stories.summary: A 17-year-old boy was pronounced dead at the scene and two 18-year-olds sustained serious injuries in a Wayne County crash. The driver has been charged with OVI.

stories.title: Cleveland Browns long snapper Rex Sunahara signs 4-year extension
stories.summary: Bay Village native Rex Sunahara will be staying with his childhood team for the next four years. He was first signed to the Browns in 2024.

stories.title: Joe Moorhead stepping down as Akron football coach after 5 seasons
stories.summary: Joe Moorhead has resigned as the Akron Zips' head football coach after five seasons and a 15-45 record.

stories.title: Ohio departments highlight successful use of Flock in breaking cases as audit deadline passes
stories.summary: Local law enforcement tout the crime-fighting benefits of license plate readers, but concerns over privacy and accountability persist as lawmaker proposes expansion.

stories.title: Lake Erie waves bring Thanksgiving surf to Cleveland as strong winds threaten shoreline
stories.summary: Lake Erie's strong winds drew surfers and kayakers to Edgewater Beach, boasting impressive but risky waves on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Thousands lose power across Northeast Ohio as Thanksgiving Day rain and wind persist
stories.summary: FirstEnergy reported more than 7,000 of its customers were without power this Thanksgiving. That number has dropped to around 1,500.

stories.title: Semi jackknifes between I-75 and off ramp near downtown Toledo
stories.summary: Crews reopened the exit ramp onto the Anthony Wayne Trail from northbound I-75 around 4:45 p.m. on Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: 3News Meteorologist Jessica Van Meter welcomes baby girl!
stories.summary: Jessica and her husband welcome baby Elizabeth, weighing 7 pounds, 14 ounces, just in time for the holidays.

stories.title: Annual Meadows Turkey Bowl in Medina County raises money for brain cancer research
stories.summary: The annual Thanksgiving event has raised more than $6 million for brain cancer research since the tradition began. This year, the turkey bowl raised nearly $675,000.
